selection: Highest source-validation macro-F1 within each fold/seed; never use test scores. Candidate fits consume the shared total budget.
limitations: Candidate order is deterministic, not a ranking of published scores.
All candidate combinations obey fixed ontology, channels, physical units and 50 Hz resampling.
Source-backed components do not imply the entire combination has published performance. No pretrained weights are used.

tinier_data.supports: Dataset-specific window durations for WISDM, UCI, HAPT, USC-HAD, MotionSense and UTD-MHAD-W.

tinier_train.supports: Standardization, natural sampling, Adam .001 and the TinierHAR training schedule.

tinier_normalize.supports: Standardization and min-max normalization implementations; min-max is a candidate, not the training default.

tinier_window.supports: Half-window displacement in the time-domain loader.

uci.supports: 2.56-second windows at 50 Hz, 50% overlap, and already-filtered released inertial signals.

unimib.supports: 151-sample, 50 Hz, event-centred accelerometer segments. Original baselines are not these neural architectures.

hangtime.supports: DeepConvLSTM-family baselines use 1-second windows, 50% overlap and one recurrent layer with 1024 hidden units.

capture.supports: 10-second wrist-acceleration windows and participant-isolated validation. 10 seconds exceeds this harness limit.

capture_augment.supports: Time warp sigma .05, knots 4, probability 1; magnitude warp sigma .05, knots 2, probability 1. Upstream also shifts windows; that shift is not used here.

real_life.supports: Uncontrolled smartphone orientation/placement; source benchmark uses SVM features, not these neural architectures.

real_life_correction.supports: Corrected 20-second segmentation and dataset results; 20 seconds exceeds this harness limit.

hart.supports: Sensor-wise HART and MobileHART architectures and training code; fixed six-channel MobileHART adapter uses 128 samples.

augmentation.supports: Wearable-signal augmentation mechanisms; candidate strengths/probabilities below are local hypotheses unless noted.

paper.supports: Benchmark architecture families, dataset scope and source-only selection. Does not disclose an exact initial pipeline per dataset.
